name: Windows
description: Windows 10/11 and Windows Server. PowerShell and built-in network tools for DNS, ports, captures, firewall, VPN, Wi-Fi, proxy, TLS, and event logs.
notes: Run PowerShell as Administrator for packet capture, firewall, and Wi-Fi report commands.
Pktmon is available on Windows 10 1809 and later.
Commands are read-only unless a workflow says otherwise.

categories.name: Connectivity
categories.description: IP configuration, routes, ping, traceroute, and port tests.

categories.name: DNS
categories.description: Resolver configuration, cache, and name lookups.

categories.name: Packet capture
categories.description: Pktmon capture with a filter and clean stop.

categories.name: Firewall
categories.description: Windows Defender Firewall profiles and rules.

categories.name: System health
categories.description: OS, memory, disks, and adapter statistics.

workflows.title: Network snapshot
workflows.summary: IP configuration, adapters, routes, and DNS servers in one pass.

workflows.title: Connectivity and port test
workflows.summary: Ping, trace, DNS, and a TCP port test to a target.

workflows.title: DNS resolution and cache
workflows.summary: Query a name, optionally through a specific server, and inspect the local resolver configuration.

workflows.title: Pktmon packet capture
workflows.summary: Filter, capture, stop, and convert a Windows packet trace to text.

variables.name: src
variables.prompt: Local or remote IP to match

steps.instruction: Reproduce the problem, then stop the capture.

notes: Run pktmon in an elevated PowerShell session.
The ETL file is in the current working directory.

workflows.title: Port listeners and owning process
workflows.summary: Find listeners on a port and identify the process using it.

workflows.title: Firewall profiles and rules
workflows.summary: Inspect Windows Defender Firewall state and the inbound rules that are enabled.
requires: Administrator PowerShell for full rule details

workflows.title: Windows VPN profile and routes
workflows.summary: Inspect a VPN profile, its connection state, and the routes it installs.

workflows.title: Wi-Fi adapter and profiles
workflows.summary: Inspect wireless state, saved profiles, and generate a WLAN report.
requires: Administrator PowerShell for the WLAN report

steps.instruction: Open the HTML report path printed by the command and inspect disconnect reasons and signal history.

notes: WLAN report generation can take a few seconds.

workflows.title: Proxy configuration
workflows.summary: Inspect machine-wide WinHTTP proxy and the current user's Internet Settings.
steps: Get-ItemProperty 'HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Internet Settings' | Select-Object ProxyEnable, ProxyServer, AutoConfigURL

workflows.title: TLS and HTTP endpoint check
workflows.summary: Test a TLS port, print the certificate chain, and inspect an HTTP response.

steps.note: Requires OpenSSL (Git for Windows, OpenSSL, or WSL).

workflows.title: System and network event logs
workflows.summary: Read the latest system events and network profile events.

workflows.title: System health
workflows.summary: OS version, memory, disks, and adapter statistics.
steps: Get-CimInstance Win32_OperatingSystem | Select-Object LastBootUpTime, FreePhysicalMemory, TotalVisibleMemorySize

workflows.title: DHCP and address state
workflows.summary: Inspect address assignment and DHCP-enabled interfaces.
